tooltip.robotica.winding_crank: Winds a Mainspring, cell or FE tool by hand: +%s FE per turn
tooltip.robotica.winding_crank_auto: Also winds from any FE source, up to %s FE/t
tooltip.robotica.solar: Generates %s FE/t in daylight with open sky
tooltip.robotica.solar_push: Pushes energy into every adjacent block
tooltip.robotica.accumulator_io: Input and output up to %s FE/t
tooltip.robotica.accumulator_faces: Accepts energy on all sides, gives it out on the front face
tooltip.robotica.charger: Charges the item in its slot at %s FE/t
tooltip.robotica.charger_mainspring: Accepts energy from any side. Mainsprings only wind at the Winding Crank
message.robotica.crank_empty: Right-click the crank with a Mainspring, a cell or an FE tool first
tooltip.robotica.winding_crank.details:
Right-click it with a Mainspring (or a cell or drill) to put it in.
Hold right-click with an empty hand to wind it.
Sneak-right-click with an empty hand shows the charge, twice takes it out.
tooltip.robotica.combustion_generator.de:
Right-click it with coal, charcoal, logs or any furnace fuel.
It pushes FE into machines touching it. Put a Tesla Coil on it to send FE further.
tooltip.robotica.solar_panel_mk1.details: Needs open sky. Pushes FE into blocks touching it.
tooltip.robotica.solar_panel_mk2.details: Needs open sky. Pushes FE into blocks touching it.
tooltip.robotica.charger.details:
Right-click it with a cell or an FE tool to charge it.
Needs FE from a generator or a Tesla Coil.
tooltip.robotica.metal_press.details:
Right-click it with ingots, or feed it with a hopper.
One ingot makes one plate: twice what the hammer gives.
tooltip.robotica.accumulator_1.details: Stores FE for the night. Put a Tesla Coil on it to send the FE to your machines.
gui.robotica.energy_rate_tip: Energy per tick, averaged over the last second
message.robotica.crank_peek: Wound: %s%% (%s / %s FE). Sneak-right-click again to take it out
tooltip.robotica.tesla_coil_source: Place it on an Accumulator or generator, link machines with a Tesla Linker
tooltip.robotica.tesla_linker.none: Sneak-right-click a Tesla Coil to select it
tooltip.robotica.tesla_linker.details:
Sneak-right-click a Tesla Coil to select it.
Right-click a machine: the side you click is where the power goes in.
Right-click another coil to chain them (5% loss per hop).
Click a linked block again to unlink it. Sneak-right-click the air to clear.
message.robotica.tesla.not_yours: This Tesla Coil belongs to someone else
message.robotica.tesla.other_dimension: The selected coil is in another dimension
message.robotica.tesla.protected: You cannot use that block here
message.robotica.tesla.full: No free links (%1$s / %2$s). Unlink something or use a higher tier
message.robotica.tesla.out_of_range: Too far: this coil reaches %3$s blocks
message.robotica.tesla.no_energy: That block does not take FE
message.robotica.tesla.wrong_face: The %4$s side takes no power. Click another side
message.robotica.tesla.own_support: A coil cannot power the block it sits on
message.robotica.tesla.reverse: That coil already sends to this one
gui.robotica.tesla_links_tip: Links in use. Machines and other coils each take one
gui.robotica.tesla_no_links: No links: use a Tesla Linker
gui.robotica.tesla_status_tip: A coil on an Accumulator or generator sends its FE. Any other coil relays what coils send it
tooltip.robotica.tesla_coil_1.details:
Place it on an Accumulator or a generator: it sends that block's FE.
On any other block it relays what other coils send it.
Link it with a Tesla Linker. Right-click it for its status.
